notes.title: ✨Translations - Ready for Primetime✨
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44566858/163e57b49bb24a0741faad389f927c3889c508f1.png[/img]

With this build, we're taking language support out of "Beta" status. This means languages are available on non-steam platforms and we're satisfied that the major issues with the translations have been solved. 📝 

Steam build was uploaded a few days ago, so you should've been able to enjoy the latest changes already! 🥳

For those who missed it last time, the supported languages are:

Spanish - LATAM
German
Simplified Chinese
Russian
Japanese
Portuguese - BR

Many issues with translations (small and not-so-small) have been fixed since the last build. Thanks to everyone who has helped with testing! 💪

If you have any further issues [i]please[/i] keep the reports coming - after making extra sure your copy is up to date! 

The other changes have been fairly minor but will un-stick a few people ✨ 

- Soft-lock in Act 3 when running a translation fixed
- Crashes with very specific item equips fixed.
- Time has been added to the manual save slots in the pause UI for some dedicated players trying to see every last dialogue line!

There has also been a very positive review of the game over on Polygon, we can tell the reviewer really vibed with the game! Give it a read if you're still on the fence👌 

https://www.polygon.com/gaming/475119/arco-review


Thanks, and enjoy! ✨

tags.bug: - Soft-lock in Act 3 when running a translation fixed
- Crashes with very specific item equips fixed.

tags.feature: - Time has been added to the manual save slots in the pause UI for some dedicated players trying to see every last dialogue line!

notes.title: New languages have arrived to Arco! 📚
notes.content:
We are very happy to announce that Arco is now available in the following languages:

- Spanish - LATAM
- German
- Simplified Chinese
- Russian
- Japanese
- Portuguese - BR

We want to say that, since the game has a lot of text and we are a small team, we are aware that you may find some misprints here and there.✍️

Even though we are checking that everything looks perfect for you, in case you find some misprints or bugs, it would help us a lot if you could report that at Steam forums.

Besides the localisation, we've made some minor audio and performance improvements, as well as some background changes to implement better the localisations.💪

Thank you so much for your patience, we hope you enjoy Arco a lot in your languages!✨

notes.title: More bugfixes, more save slots and in-game lyrics!
notes.content:
[h3]Thank you everyone for your reviews! We've reached Overwhelmingly Positive which I officially puts us in the cool kids gang and will grant us entry to gamedev valhalla. 🫡

We're still working on localisation and expecting to deliver it soon™. Meanwhile we're pushing this patch with smaller changes and lots of bugcrash fixes.

Switch has also received a patch recently and we'll keep updating it to make sure it's quality matches the steam version.

[/h3]
[h1]Patch Summary[/h1]
[b][list]
[*] Reworked save menu and allowed more save slots
[*] Added subtitles to in-game songs.
[*] Fixed a lot of crashes.
[/list][/b]

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] New load/save menu with 5 manual and 10 auto saves, and fixed some graphics bugs there
[*] Added song subtitles
[*] Couple patches to player combat inventory, so killed characters drop ALL their items and also so it doesn't get duplicated if you win the combat and get back
[*] Added camera pan scaler so that people who are motion sick can turn it off
[*] Adjusted Itzae skill tree so the passive upgrades are visible right away
[*] Restored character HP in starting bar silently when they are re-added 
[*] Now coins show correctly if you have 99+ coins
[*] Added healing loot before bog ambush so players don't get instakilled
[*] Made it so you don't have to have Atzi to dig up previously discovered gold and some other Atzi interactions
[*] Added flags to avoid accidentally skipping Holyground interaction
[*] Fixed various description inconsitencies and typos
[*] Patch so teleport works as dash on Mountain Temple
[*] Reworked Lamb logic so Zoka and Lamb are different events and trigger independently
[*] Ending Guilt threshold adjustement

[*] Nerfed Brace slightly.
[*] Nerfed mushroom spread mushrooms slightly

[*] Fixed goat mission and password box
[*] Fixed (some) infinite money exploits
[*] Fixed El Gallo fight not triggering animations
[*] Fixed line drawing cache potentially growing forever
[*] Fixed skeleton talking even if you killed him
[*] Fixed bug with fires in RC_HQ 
[*] Fixed ending achievement
[*] Fixed clifftops watchtower crash
[*] Fixed El Gallo fight animations and ending explosions killing player
[*] Fixed crash in revive corpse action
[*] Fixed inv lost reference crash
[*] Fixed minecarts and fuel tanks so they can't be exploded with Explode Corpse
[*] Fixed quick_shot_dash action crash
[*] Fixed one of the temple combats not self-completing

[*] Added SetProcessDPIAware for Windows to hopefully avoid blurriness on high DPI screens
[*] Added high DPI window flag for Mac (separately handled on Windows)
[/list]

notes.title: Bugfixes, Demo, Assist Mode, and What's Next
notes.content:
[h3]First of all thank you everyone for enjoying Arco, and reporting all the bugs!

If you played Arco but haven't left a reivew yet, please do, it helps 💕[/h3]

[h2]Patch summary[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Lots of crash and bug fixes.[/b] Let us know if you find anything we missed.
[*] [b]Demo![/b] Some people asked so we brought the free demo back! It's important to notice that the demo is the first 2-3 hours of the game and that the saves carry over to the final, if you choose to buy, so it is the best way to see if you like the game!
[*] [b]Assist mode in settings[/b] for players who care about the story but are struggling with combat. You can use it to blow stuff up, skip combat and turn off ghosts. We recommend experiencing the game without it, but we want to make sure everyone can get the most fun out of the game. 
[*] [b]Option to skip Act I when replaying the game.[/b] To make Obelisk hunting and looking for alternate paths a more pleasant process.
[*] [b]Holding space previews bullet paths.[/b] Thanks for the suggestion.
[/list]

[h2]What's next[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Localisation.[/b] Arco will be translated into 6 languages:
- Spanish - LATAM
- German
- Simplified Chinese
- Russian
- Japanese
- Portuguese - BR
The translations are planned to release before end of the month on Steam.
[*] [b]Switch patches.[/b] We realise Switch version of the game runs worse than PC and has additional bugs. There's a Patch on the way addressing the main issues. As we can't instantly push new changes to Switch, the fixes there will lag behind the ones here. Hope you understand. We hope that the upcoming Switch patch will be accepted by Nintendo in the following week.
[*] [b]More and more fixes.[/b] Hopefully, most of the issues are now resolved, but we'll keep an eye out for more bug reports and tackle them asap. 
[/list]

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
- Fixed 2x Mana Buff sometimes not working in combat
- Assist Mode
- Added Act 1 skip when replaying the game.
- Fixed some Achievements not triggering.
- Changed scenario summary presentation a little
- Patched accidentally leaving Zoka behind
- Typo fixes
- Increased draw scale for the pre-fight UI in encounter for comfortable reading on Switch/Deck
- Fixed use button visible for one frame if it shouldn't be on opening inventory
- Fixed crash in boss_moth
- Rattler mission hints
- Fixed lizard egg softlock 
- Patched items that do damage when consumed so they don't break the game if used in pre-battle
- Fixed Chali trader shop crash
- Fixed wrong-size overlay with funny res
- Less blinding crash screen
- Reworked Sprite Caching
- Fixed infinite money loop (one of em at least)
- Bunch of skill description fixes
- Fixed Revive Corpse crash
- Added missing 'worm ghost' description
- Fixed being able to take Zoka past the forest
- Fixed train wormhole
- Fixed archeology minigame crash
- Added missing mana pickup description
- Fixed kid ball mission not finishing
- Added bullet paths visible when holding space

[b]First person to find another crash on Steam and ask gets a key for their friend >:)[/b]

notes.title: Mac compatibility and Resolution fixes
notes.content:
Thanks for playing and all the feedback, looking forward to more of your thoughts.
We have updated the demo with the following changes:

[list]
[*] Added Mac support
[*] Game is locked to 16:9 ratio now, which should prevent any elements from being out of the screen
[*] Some crashes and small bugs have been fixed.
[/list]

Enjoy :)
